UNKNOWN: An unknown error occurred. Please try again later.
MISSING_LOGIN_PARAMETERS: Required instance login parameters are missing.
INSTANCE_NOT_FOUND: The requested instance was not found.
INSTANCE_CONFIG_INVALID: The instance configuration could not be parsed. Check the instance settings in the console.
INVALID_INSTANCE_CREDENTIALS: The access username or password is incorrect.
INSTANCE_PASSWORD_UNAVAILABLE: The instance access password could not be retrieved or decrypted. Save the password again and redeploy the instance.
INSTANCE_AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED: Login protection is not enabled for this instance. Configure an administrator username and password, then redeploy.
INSTANCE_AUTH_CHAIN_NOT_READY: The Agent authentication chain is not ready yet. Try the readiness check again shortly. Reason: {{reason}}
INSTANCE_SESSION_COOKIE_MISSING: The Agent responded but did not establish a valid login session. Try again shortly or redeploy the instance.
INSTANCE_SESSION_BRIDGE_FAILED: The Agent Web login session could not be synchronized. Try again shortly. Reason: {{reason}}
INSTANCE_SESSION_UNAUTHORIZED: The access session is unauthorized or has expired. Please sign in again.
INSTANCE_LOGIN_RATE_LIMITED: Too many login requests were sent. Please try again later.
INSTANCE_NETWORK_NOT_READY: The Agent network is not ready or the instance is still starting. Wait a moment and try again.
INSTANCE_LOGIN_ENDPOINT_FAILED: The Agent login endpoint is temporarily unavailable. Check the instance status and runtime logs.
INSTANCE_LOGIN_INTERNAL_ERROR: The instance login service encountered an internal error. Please try again later.
INSTANCE_READINESS_INTERNAL_ERROR: The instance readiness check failed. Please try the check again later.
CREDENTIALS_LOAD_FAILED: The credential list could not be loaded. Please try again later.
CREDENTIAL_FIELDS_REQUIRED: Complete the credential name, type, and API key fields.
CREDENTIAL_SECRET_INVALID: The credential value is invalid. Enter the actual API key.
CREDENTIAL_BASE_URL_UNSAFE: The base URL did not pass the security check. Verify the address and try again.
CREDENTIAL_CREATE_FAILED: The credential could not be created. Please try again later.
CREDENTIAL_UPDATE_FAILED: The credential could not be updated. Please try again later.
CREDENTIAL_DELETE_FAILED: The credential could not be deleted. It may currently be in use.
CREDENTIAL_IN_USE: This model credential is still referenced by an instance. Replace it there before deleting it.
CREDENTIAL_RATE_LIMITED: Credential operations are being performed too frequently. Please try again later.
INSTANCE_CHANNEL_MANAGE_FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to manage channels for this instance.
CHANNEL_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED: Confirm that both a real inbound message and outbound reply succeeded.
CHANNEL_ACCEPTANCE_NOT_REQUIRED: This channel does not require external message verification.
CHANNEL_NOT_CONNECTED: The channel is not connected. Recheck the channel status first.
